summary.text: Andrea Olsen is a Democratic member of the Montana State Senate representing District 48 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she previously served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Andrea Olsen was born and raised in Missoula, Montana, and graduated from Hellgate High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree, with honors, and a J.D. from the University of Montana.
Olsen served in the Montana House of Representatives, District 100, from 2015 to 2023.
In the 2025-2026 legislative session, Ballotpedia lists her on the Education and Cultural Resources, Highways and Transportation, and Senate Judiciary committees, with a vice chair role on Judiciary.
